# Rain on Glass (`rainGlass`)

Raindrops bead and run down a window over a blurred city at night.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: heavy (~7.2 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Rainy Window

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `rain` | Rain | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `fog` | Condensation | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `blur` | City Blur | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.7 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Night | {"r":0.05,"g":0.07,"b":0.12} |
| `colorB` | City Lights | {"r":1,"g":0.7,"b":0.4} |

## In a style

```json
{"kind": "rainGlass", "params": {"speed": 1, "rain": 0.6, "fog": 0.6}}
```
